description: This Java source file defines the 'DisplayActivity' class for an Android application. It manages the display of Picasa's featured images, handles fragment transactions, full-screen mode toggling, and responds to broadcast messages related to image downloading and viewing. The class coordinates various fragments within the activity, manages UI state (such as side-by-side display and navigation hiding), and interfaces with background services for image downloading.

classes.name: DownloadStateReceiver
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver subclass that listens for status updates from the image download service and updates UI fragments accordingly.

classes.name: FragmentDisplayer
classes.description: A BroadcastReceiver subclass that manages display of images and zoom actions based on received intents.

methods.name: setFullScreen
methods.description: Configures the activity to enter or exit full-screen mode, adjusting window flags and UI visibility.

methods.name: onBackStackChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in the fragment back stack, mainly to exit full-screen mode when navigating backwards.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current full-screen state before the activity might be destroyed.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up full-screen flags, inflates the layout, registers broadcast receivers, and initializes fragments.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Unregisters broadcast receivers and performs cleanup.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Cancels ongoing background photo download threads.
